title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
summary: Jacob Devlin, Ming-Wei Chang, Kenton Lee and Kristina Toutanova submitted BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding on October 11, 2018. The paper introduced BERT, a bidirectional Transformer-based language representation model pretrained from unlabeled text and designed for fine-tuning across downstream natural-language-processing tasks.
significance: A documented language-model milestone introducing BERT and its bidirectional pretraining approach for transfer to multiple natural-language-processing tasks.

verification.note: Title, authors, October 11 2018 submission date and the paper's description of BERT as a bidirectional pretrained language representation model are supported by the original arXiv record; Google Research independently identifies the same authors and publication work. No later conference-publication date is substituted for the documented 2018 preprint event.
